name: Is hydro-jetting or snaking better for tree root removal?

mainEntity.name: Is hydro-jetting or snaking better for tree root removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hydro-jetting uses high-pressure water to clear roots and thoroughly clean the pipe walls, removing sludge and debris. Snaking, or augering, uses a rotating blade to cut through roots, mainly creating a path for flow. Hydro-jetting is generally more effective for comprehensive root removal and cleaning, while snaking is good for breaking through initial blockages. We recommend based on inspection findings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hydro-jetting uses high-pressure water for thorough cleaning, while snaking cuts through roots. Hydro-jetting is often more comprehensive.
